title: NarraFlow
noProjects: No narraflows yet. Create one to get started.
repositoryPathDescription: Local path to an existing git repository
initPathDescription: Path where the new repository will be created
repoModeExistingDesc: Link an existing local Git repository
repoModeInitDesc: Create a brand new Git repository at the specified path
repoModeCloneDesc: Clone a remote repository to a local path
deleteProjectConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This will remove all chapters, narrators, terminals, and containers. The original repository files will not be affected.
deleteProjectTypeName: Type the narraflow name to confirm:
commandsDesc: Define slash commands available to all narrators in this narraflow. NarraFlow commands override user commands with the same name.
commandPromptPlaceholder: Enter the prompt text. Use {{input}} as a placeholder.
commandEmpty: No narraflow commands. Add one to get started.
commandDuplicateName: A command with this name already exists
routinesDesc: Enable or disable built-in commands and skills for this narraflow. Override the global setting per routine.
skillsDesc: Skills are reusable instruction sets that provide domain-specific knowledge to narrators. Place SKILL.md files in .narrafork/skills/<name>/ directory.
skillsEmpty: No skills found. Create a .narrafork/skills/<name>/SKILL.md file to get started.
proxyDomainDesc: Base domain for container proxy subdomains. Each container port gets a subdomain like {chapterId}-{service}-{port}.{domain}.
proxyDomainHint: Requires wildcard DNS: *.{domain} → server IP. For local dev, use *.localhost or configure dnsmasq.
proxyDomainInvalid: Please enter a valid domain (e.g. dev.example.com, without http:// or paths)
projectWhitelistDirsDesc: Directories auto-allowed for narrators in this project.
projectBlacklistDirsDesc: Directories blocked for narrators in this project.
